title: A/R Detail: exports list every ticked location by name
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open A/R documents at three locations, {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}, and you are enrolled at all three.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310 and {Location-C} is another staging location.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Read the Locations line under the PDF's title.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. Read the Locations line at the top of the CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Location-A} and {Location-C} stay ticked; the chip reads "Location: 2 locations".
  • Step 2: the PDF downloads.
  • Step 3: it reads "Locations: " followed by the names of {Location-A} and {Location-C}, and not {Location-B}.
  • Step 4: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 5: the same Locations line, with both names.

The order and separator of several location names are not stated in the PRD (question 12); the case checks that both names, and only they, appear.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S3-R5: “Each export states the locations under the as-of line: "Locations: All locations" when every location is ticked, otherwise "Locations: " followed by the ticked locations' names. Under it, only when set: "Past due: " and the ticked ranges in menu order (for example "Past due: 31-60 days, 91+ days"), then, for one ticked customer or vendor, "Customer: " or "Vendor: " and the name, and for several, "Customers: " or "Vendors: " and the names in the order they were ticked.”
  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”
